# AgentMixer

> AgentMixer gives applications provider-neutral routing, shared account custody, and a bounded tool broker for Codex and Claude agents under explicit runtime qualification.

When to use this site:
- Use agentmixer.dev to learn what AgentMixer is, which providers it supports, and how the tool broker bounds what an agent can reach.
- Use /docs for the complete README: install, adapters, qualification, account custody, capability profiles, and release notes.

## Pages

- [AgentMixer](https://agentmixer.dev/): a qualified execution seam for coding agents — provider-neutral routing, shared account custody, and a scoped tool broker.
- [AgentMixer documentation](https://agentmixer.dev/docs): the complete AgentMixer README.

## Optional

- [sitemap](https://agentmixer.dev/sitemap.xml): Indexable HTML URLs.
